capabilities: Apply status dots to files and folders.
Define custom status sets and colors.
Assign statuses per folder with defaults.
Group and sort contents by status.
extras: All status assignments are stored locally in the plugin's data file, ensuring no changes are written to note content.
problem: Users need a visual way to track the state (e.g., 'in progress', 'done') of files and folders directly within the file explorer.
summary: Applies reusable, traffic-light style status icons to files and folders in the Obsidian file tree, allowing custom statuses and grouping.
